$comment: LIVE-1 / ADR-0165 — the CubeSandbox template contract for the live display.
specVersion 3 (2026-08-16, #1438 실기동 E2E). specVersion 2 was a DECLARED
contract; this version records what was MEASURED end to end on momo-cube-host
(101.79.18.230) + momo-turn (223.130.142.109): a real microVM producer whose
H264 screen reached an external browser (a Mac on the public internet) over a
WebRTC media stream relayed through the oort TURN. The three items that

runtimeVerified.$comment: #1438 measured 2026-08-16. Evidence: external Chromium rendered display-e2e-1438 at 1280x720, 56 frames decoded, media candidate pair relay<->relay; coturn logged ALLOCATE+CHANNEL_BIND success from BOTH the producer (101.79.18.230) and the browser (39.115.69.188), over TURN transport=udp AND transport=tcp.

$comment: The template is built by `cubemastercli tpl create-from-image` from an OCI
image, NOT by systemd. PID 1 is the #1437 bootstrap receiver, which lands
the create-time envVars delivery and then execs the entrypoint.
MUST be built WITHOUT `--probe`: the producer legitimately does not listen
on :8452 until after the create-time delivery arrives, and no delivery
happens during a template build. A display template built with --probe or
without the receiver fails EVERY envVars create with 500 (130497), which is
the exact state the real T3 adapter provisions in (#1437/#1434).
template.ordering: entrypoint.sh, not a systemd unit — adds the ICE base (see network.iceBase), starts Xvfb, waits on the X socket, then execs the producer
template.$requiresIproute2Comment: iproute2 must be in the rootfs so entrypoint can add the routable ICE base; without it, relay gathering fails (see network.iceBase).

$comment: ADR-0165 D1 named Selkies-GStreamer first with `webrtcbin` as the
alternative; this template declares the alternative on the D4 structural
argument (view-only = ABSENCE of an input datachannel). #1438 RESOLVED the
producerSelection unknown: webrtcbin encodes H264 acceptably inside a
GPU-less microVM and an external browser decoded 56 frames at 1280x720.
Swapping the producer is still a one-field change here plus the unit file;
nothing in server-rust names a producer.
producer.$inputComment: ADR-0165 D4. RUNTIME-VERIFIED (#1438): the producer OFFER carried m=video a=sendonly and NO m=application, measured against the real producer through the host proxy from an external browser.

inputDatachannelOnDemand.$comment: LIVE-3 / ADR-0004 증보 3. STILL runtime-unverified — see unverified.inputDelivery. #1438 measured view-only media only.

hostProxy.$comment: ADR-0165 증보 1 D2-1. RUNTIME-VERIFIED (#1438): external browser -> wss://<host-public>:8443/display/signal/<displayId> -> nginx (형상 A, client-IP preserving) -> microVM :8452. TLS is self-signed in the E2E; a real cert is a follow-up (runbook §9 item 2).

$policyComment: (D3-1) established relay is the only viable path (symmetric NAT). #1438
measured a DEEPER reason the producer must force relay AND the template
must supply a routable ICE base: see network.iceBase.

turn.credentialDelivery: per-session ephemeral (LIVE-5a): the producer reads `ice_servers` off its own display-attach/validate answer and renders it into webrtcbin's `turn://` spelling at pipeline construction. The pre-LIVE-5a static long-term cred delivered via envVars (#1437 receiver) as MOMO_DISPLAY_TURN_URI is now the FALLBACK: an instance whose momo-server was given no MOMO_TURN_STATIC_AUTH_SECRET answers `ice_servers: []` and the static path carries it unchanged.
turn.credentialPreference: server-minted wins over the envVars static whenever `ice_servers` is non-empty
$credentialRefreshComment: The server re-mints on every 30s re-validation; the producer installs a
credential ONCE, at pipeline construction, and discards every later mint.
GStreamer cannot swap a TURN server on a running ICE agent, and the one
property that looks like a way in (webrtcbin.ice-agent) DESTROYS the agent
when read — measured in #1438, see network.mediaUdpPortRange.
So the TTL is a PER-PEER-CONNECTION CEILING, not a sliding window: past it
that connection can no longer allocate or refresh a relay and the viewer's
screen goes black with nothing user-visible to explain it. A NEW viewer is
unaffected (new Session, new pipeline, credential minted at attach).
$credentialComment: The server mint is coturn's `use-auth-secret` derivation:
SHA-1 is fixed by WebRTC's STUN MESSAGE-INTEGRITY rather than chosen —
MEASURED 2026-08-18 against the LIVE momo-turn (223.130.142.109) from an
external Mac, RFC 5766 ALLOCATE: the STATIC credential still allocates over
udp AND tcp (relayed 223.130.142.109:*, lifetime 600s, realm oort.turn), and
an EPHEMERAL credential is refused 401 — `use-auth-secret` is NOT yet enabled
on the relay. So the server half of this contract is landed and proved in
conformance while the relay half is an operator step, in that order and never
the reverse: momo-turn carries production traffic, and the static credential
is not removed until the ephemeral one is measured working beside it
turn.$comment: CHANGED from null. #1438 RESOLVED iceReachability: the producer allocates a relay on momo-turn and the browser connects relay<->relay. coturn logged ALLOCATE success from the microVM (via host egress 101.79.18.230) over both udp and tcp.

ice.requiresAdrAmendment: ADR-0165 증보 2 — turn is now REQUIRED (was 'introduce only if measured necessary'). #1438 is that measurement. The producer forces iceTransportPolicy=relay and the template supplies a routable ICE base.

$comment: CHANGED to enforced:false. GStreamer 1.22 webrtcbin has NO port-range
property, and reading `ice-agent` to reach the underlying ICE object
DESTROYS it (over-unref → later negotiation dies on GST_IS_WEBRTC_ICE
assertion) — do not read it. The microVM media ports are therefore not
constrained here. In the relay topology it does not matter: media does
not ingress to the microVM on these ports — it egresses to the TURN and
is relayed, so the ports that face the internet are momo-turn's
49152-65535 range, not these.
NEW in specVersion 3 — the #1438 root-cause finding. A CubeSandbox
microVM's guest eth0 carries ONLY link-local addresses (IPv4
169.254.68.6/30, IPv6 fe80::). libnice (webrtcbin's ICE stack) REGISTERS
the TURN but schedules NO STUN/TURN candidate discovery from a link-local
base — measured 'Candidate gathering FINISHED, no scheduled items' — so
the producer emits ZERO candidates and cannot allocate a relay, even
though the TURN works and the microVM can reach it (raw-socket STUN got a
reply). The fix, measured to work: entrypoint adds a routable RFC1918
address to eth0 (default 10.99.0.2/24) BEFORE the producer starts. libnice
then uses it as a base, allocates the relay, and the CubeNet gateway
MASQUERADEs the flow out the host's public IP and returns the reply.
The identical producer needed no such fix in a container (it already had
an RFC1918 172.17.x address) — this is specific to the microVM's
link-local-only posture.
iceBase.addedBy: entrypoint (needs iproute2 + CAP_NET_ADMIN, which PID1 in a microVM has)

unverified.$comment: specVersion 2's producerSelection / iceReachability / templateBuild are RESOLVED (see runtimeVerified). Only inputDelivery remains.
unverified.inputDelivery: LIVE-3 control reaching a screen is STILL unverified. #1438 measured view-only media end to end; no producer has read input_enabled:true, opened an input datachannel, delivered a keystroke, or closed the channel on window return. That is LIVE-5, out of #1438 scope.
unverified.realTlsCert: The host proxy used a self-signed cert in the E2E (browser launched with ignore-cert-errors). A real cert/domain is a follow-up (runbook §9 item 2).
unverified.serverValidateWiring: #1438 used MOMO_DISPLAY_STUB_VALIDATE=1 to isolate media reachability. The producer's real server-side capability validate (against a live LIVE-1..4 server) is exercised at the contract level by display_attach_conformance_pg.rs but was not wired into this live media run. LIVE-5a corrected the request field it would have failed on (`capability_token`, not `capability` — the DTO is deny_unknown_fields, so every real call was a 400) and now reads `ice_servers` out of that answer; the producer still holds no work-host signing key, so the call remains unmade by any running producer. That is LIVE-5c.
unverified.relayCredentialRetirement: The ephemeral credential path is landed on BOTH sides (server mints, producer prefers) and proved in conformance, but momo-turn itself still runs `lt-cred-mech` + a static `user=` line — measured 2026-08-18: static ALLOCATE succeeds, ephemeral ALLOCATE is 401. Enabling `use-auth-secret` on the relay, measuring both credentials side by side, and only then deleting the `user=` line is docs/runbooks/turn-host-install.md §6 and has NOT been performed.
unverified.credentialCeiling: UNMEASURED and structural: the producer installs a TURN credential once per peer connection and discards the re-validation's later mints (see ice.turn.$credentialRefreshComment), so a continuous stream that outlives MOMO_TURN_CREDENTIAL_TTL_SECONDS loses its relay with no user-visible cause. Nothing has watched a stream past a TTL, so the failure mode is reasoned from the GStreamer constraint rather than observed. LIVE-5c AC: run one stream past the TTL on momo-cube-host and decide between (a) ICE renegotiation on a fresh credential and (b) accepting the TTL as a session ceiling with the surface saying so. Do NOT attempt the renegotiation implementation before that measurement — LIVE-5a deliberately did not.
